# Play By Ear

Play By Ear is a fractional GTM agency and event-hosting studio for emerging technology, founded by Marlene Ronstedt.

Site: https://www.playbyear.xyz/

## What Play By Ear Does

- Fractional GTM leadership for blockchain, fintech, AI, and developer-tool companies
- Hands-on GTM agency support across positioning, narrative, launches, partner coordination, and ecosystem campaigns
- MCing, event hosting, panel moderation, demo day hosting, hackathon hosting, and onstage facilitation
- Occasional vibe coding workshops for non-technical teams and events

## GTM Summary

Play By Ear supports blockchain, fintech, AI, and developer-tool companies as a fractional GTM partner and hands-on agency. Engagements cover positioning, narrative, launch strategy, ecosystem campaigns, partner coordination, campaign assets, and execution.

## Hosting Summary

Marlene Ronstedt is bookable through Play By Ear as an MC, event host, panel moderator, demo day host, hackathon host, and onstage facilitator for AI, tech, crypto, startup, conference, and developer events worldwide.

## Workshop Summary

Play By Ear occasionally runs two-hour hands-on vibe coding workshops where non-technical participants build and publish a live website using AI-assisted coding tools.

## Contact

For fractional GTM, GTM agency, event hosting, and project inquiries, use https://www.playbyear.xyz/contact or book a discovery call from the site.
